name: General Knowledge Rich Pack
description: 15 questions with increasing difficulty, formatted for a Who Wants to Be Rich-style game.
creator: ChatGPT

questions.text: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
questions.explanation: Mars appears reddish because of iron oxide (rust) on its surface.

questions.text: What is the largest ocean on Earth?
questions.explanation: The Pacific Ocean covers more area than all of Earth's land combined.

questions.text: In basic arithmetic, what is the result of 12 × 8?
Which element has the chemical symbol 'O'?
questions.explanation: O is the symbol for oxygen; Os is the symbol for osmium.

questions.text: What is the smallest prime number greater than 10?
questions.explanation: 11 is prime; 12 is composite; 13 is prime but not the smallest > 10.

questions.text: Which painting is Leonardo da Vinci famous for creating?
questions.explanation: The 'Mona Lisa' is one of Leonardo da Vinci’s most famous works.

questions.text: In computing, what does the acronym 'CPU' stand for?
questions.explanation: CPU stands for Central Processing Unit—the primary processor of a computer.

questions.text: Which gas makes up the largest percentage of Earth's atmosphere?
questions.explanation: Earth’s atmosphere is about 78% nitrogen and about 21% oxygen.

questions.text: Which city is known as the 'City of Canals'?
questions.explanation: Venice is famous for its extensive canal network and gondolas.

questions.text: What is the term for a word that is spelled the same forwards and backwards?
questions.explanation: A palindrome reads the same in both directions, like 'racecar'.

questions.text: Which of these countries is NOT a member of the European Union?
questions.explanation: Norway is in the European Economic Area but is not an EU member.

questions.text: In classical mythology, who is the Greek god of the sea?
questions.explanation: Poseidon rules the seas, earthquakes, and horses in Greek mythology.

questions.text: What is the name of the boundary that surrounds a black hole beyond which nothing can escape?
questions.explanation: The event horizon is the point of no return for light and matter.

questions.text: Which of these is the largest moon in the Solar System?
questions.explanation: Ganymede (a moon of Jupiter) is larger than Mercury.
